title: Automatically return to customer after edit contact or address

posts.name: volkswagner
posts.cooked:
I’ve been noticing various updates have alternating behavior.

Some updates enable the function of automatically returning to the customer record when editing an address or contact via the “edit” link int Customer > Address & Contact tab.

Does anyone know where the code is that influences this behavior?

It seems when creating a new address or contact from the customer record, we are always returned to the customer record after save, but when editing the address/contact from the customer record the behavior changes depending which updates have been applied to Version-15 branch.
